title: DGX Spark MSE and BF16 numeric microprobes

static_max_mse.replication_note: Not a complete reproduction of the original PTQ environment (Torch 2.14 / nv26.8).
static_max_mse.interpretation: Supports objective separation for this synthetic fixture only; not whole-model causality or repair evidence.

beta_bf16_decode.interpretation: Agreement is limited to 8 beta points; it does not establish global or whole-HF-kernel equivalence. Single-step output and state deltas are finite and nonzero.

limitations: The MSE experiment uses synthetic tensors and does not establish whole-model causality, deployment effect, quality improvement, or repair.

The ModelOpt 0.47.0 recipe-native experiment used a historical serving image with Torch 2.13.0+cu130 and an offline overlay; it is not a complete reproduction of the original PTQ Torch 2.14 / nv26.8 environment.
The beta comparison is a single-step numeric probe; the 8-point roundtrip check is not a domain-wide or whole Hugging Face kernel equivalence claim.
Earlier failed probes were affected by diagnostic-code and cache-environment issues that have since been fixed; those failures are not evidence of a weight fault.
